section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single testing session where participants completed several online surveys. These surveys included a demographic questionnaire, personality scales, creativity measures such as the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), and intelligence measures like the Word Knowledge Test and an abbreviated Raven's Progressive Matrices Test. The text notes that some participants did not complete all measures, leading to slight variations in degrees of freedom for analyses.
